{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the number of rows and duplicates
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Number of unique patient_id: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id: {len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check how many -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {(df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()}")

# Check assay_batch values
print(f"Unique assay_batch values: {df['assay_batch'].unique()}")

# Check sample_seq distribution
print(f"Max sample_seq: {df['sample_seq'].max()}")"}
